Streptococcus pneumoniae Capsular Reference Database & Whole-Genome Serotyping

End-to-end validation of HTTP/2 sequence fetching (httpx2 + cassetter), MCL homology clustering (Loci.cluster_genes), consensus pan-locus graph layout (LayoutEngine), whole-genome serotyping (LocusPredictor + LocusMatcher), and contig-split stitching (FRAGMENTED_VARIANT).

2. Reference All-vs-All Similarity & Whole-Genome Serotyping

Left: Pairwise LocusMatcher similarity matrix across the 18-serotype reference panel (highlighting cross-reacting serogroups 6A/6B/6C/6D, 19A/19F, and 23A/23B/23F). Right: Top-1 vs. Top-2 runner-up score separation on complete RefSeq chromosomes.

3. Contig-Split Stitching & Leave-One-Out Novelty Detection

Left: LocusPredictor(stitch_contig_splits=True) reconstructs cps operons split across reverse-complemented contigs (both intergenic and mid-ORF breaks). Right: Holding out each query strain's true serotype from the reference database triggers Match.is_novel (GENE_VARIANT) and falls back to the closest intra-serogroup relative.
